diagnosis: The exact payload-free subtype plus job-scoped PostgreSQL join identifies an all-navigate_code provider batch whose logical call count exceeded the one durable attempt remaining after seven serial reservations. The preflight rejected that complete final batch before its callbacks, but the same Worker execution had already made seven authorized attempts in earlier provider turns and retained one accepted SourceEvidence receipt. The aggregate row was therefore current-job partial progress, not template residue and not a zero-effect execution.
required_correction: Retain complete-turn identity/name/state preflight and serial durable reservation, but treat an all-navigation response of at most the job-wide eight-call handling envelope as recoverable when it exceeds only current remaining capacity: invoke the capacity-fitting prefix in provider order, emit one closed payload-free budget-exhausted result for every excess original call ID without reservation or callback, and permit the next provider turn to submit. Continue rejecting more than eight calls in one response, mixed or submission batches, malformed identities, unavailable navigation state, and turn-ineligible shapes. Prove no ninth durable attempt, complete call/result replay, no request eleven, and turn-ten terminal submission behavior before another live retry.
privacy: The provider received only the approved job-1 bounded source/context. No credential, header, request/response body, source, prompt, function name, call ID, call count, argument/result, free-form content, validator detail, or host path was logged or persisted. The exact call count remains undisclosed; the subtype establishes only that it exceeded the one remaining durable attempt. Jobs 2 and 3 were not sent. Database inspection retained only current-job durable counters, state, and the closed receipt outcome.
summary: T084 r19 pinpoints a repository policy defect: DeepSeek legally emitted an all-navigation batch larger than the one remaining durable attempt, and Vulgata discarded the whole final batch instead of executing its bounded prefix and returning closed results for excess siblings. Seven earlier authorized attempts and one evidence receipt remain durable; no Document or Pass 1 outcome was written.
